active-directory.cause: Directory authentication is blocked by a lockout; stale credentials are one possible source.

vpn-troubleshooting.cause: Saved VPN credentials or a client authentication state may be stale after a password change.

dns-troubleshooting.cause: An incorrect DNS server, stale cache or missing record may prevent name resolution.

printer-troubleshooting.cause: The printer connection, queue or spooler may be unavailable; confirm which layer is failing.

windows-support.cause: Low disk space, a recent change or resource pressure may be causing Windows performance issues.

microsoft365.cause: An expired sign-in session or a tenant authentication policy may be interrupting Outlook access.

network-drive.cause: An SMB session, group membership or share/NTFS permission mismatch may deny access.

erp-access.cause: The ERP service, backend connectivity or application authorization may be failing.
